We are a leading security provider and deliver high-quality, customer driven security and locksmith solutions to clients in specialist industries in a broad range of sectors including defence, government, financial and corporate.
 
ARA is seeking a talented and experienced Human Resource Manager to join their HR team to help support the growth. 

Location: 9B Commercial Rd, Kingsgrove NSW 2208
Full time: 38 hours per week
Salary: $80,000.00 per annum + Superannuation

Key Responsibilities will include:
- Develop, implement, monitor, review, and evaluate human resource strategies, policies, and plans that support organisational goals and business objectives
- Provide guidance and support to managers on best practices for recruitment, selection, onboarding, training and employee development

- Lead employee relations by representing the organisation in negotiations with employees and unions regarding remuneration employment conditions and workplace agreements
- Develop and oversee occupational health and safety initiatives, and equal employment opportunity programs, ensuring compliance with relevant legislation and regulations.

- Strong knowledge of human resource management principles, employment legislation, and workplace relations

- Excellent communication and teamwork skills 
- Min 1 year of experience in a related field

If you meet the above criteria and you're interested in contributing to an organisation that values the highest level of quality in everything it sets out to achieve, we want to hear from you!

Salary range $85,000 - $90,000

Manages all property technology planning, decision-making, implementation, maintenance, and disposal. Engages with technology partners, owners, executive committee, and property staff to understand business needs/issues and formulate information technology (IT) related solutions. Manages property internet support. Manages the cluster team in the absence of Cluster/Multi-Property IT Manager. Communicates effectively with all stakeholders.

CANDIDATE PROFILE 

Education and Experience 

• Hospitality Management or related education, awareness of global hospitality technology trends; experience in assignments at
international locations. Back of the house and guest facing operational and technical experience with hospitality management systems. Minimum 1 year in an Associate Supervisory role.

OR

• Bachelor’s degree level or equivalent and 1 year project management experience. 
 

Solid Technical Knowledge on:

• Server and Active Directory Architecture and Security implementation.

• Windows Server Operating System and Active Directory.

• Desktop Operating iT and Desktop Management (GPO).

• Outlook email and approved mobile devices.

• IT organization and resources available.

• LAN Networks.

• Understanding of the company’s technical standards and policies.

Other Skills 

• Competent written and spoken English skills.

• Demonstrated leadership skills.

• Past Project Management and Organization skills

• Proven negotiation skills.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES 

General

Product

• Seeks to keep informed regarding technology partner activities and priorities.

People

• Builds and maintains positive and effective relations with all the stakeholders.

• Build and maintain positive and effective relations with direct team members.

Process

• Generates systems communications for property users to provide user tips, alert users of system problems, and inform staff of progress or status.

• Monitors effective flow of issue management amongst Continent Support Desk, technology partners and cluster organizations.

• Attends Bi-weekly Regional iT Calls.
